findings.entity: mirror reflection of man vs real man's head orientation
findings.description: The real man is seen from behind with his head turned so his right cheek, ear and nose show in near-full profile, pointing toward frame right, roughly parallel to the mirror surface. The mirror faces the camera at only a modest angle. Given that, his reflection should show a strongly turned or profile face. Instead it shows a near-frontal face with square shoulders looking toward the camera, as if a second camera were in front of him. This persists through most of the clip (e.g. 00:00, 00:05, 00:06.5, 00:08) and does not fit the real man's pose or the camera position.
